name: Swapkin
author: SirAllap
description: Never get blocked by coding agent limits again — Swapkin tracks weekly pace across Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and your own providers, and switches accounts from the Omarchy bar in one click.

barWidget.description: Usage limits, weekly budget pace and token history for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and custom providers, plus switching between accounts. The idle account's limits stay visible, dimmed.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.

schema.label: Watchdog interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often Swapkin refreshes limits in the background, warns near the cap, and hands over when an account is spent.

schema.label: Weekly budget spread over
schema.description: Working days: only the days and hours below earn weekly budget. Every day: the budget grows evenly all week. With no working day picked, it behaves like Every day.

schema.label: Working days
schema.description: Comma-separated day names, for example Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri. Ranges such as Mon-Fri are not supported.

schema.label: Work ends (hour)
schema.description: If the end is not after the start, the budget behaves like Every day.
